title: Corrections Policy | BettaFish.website
description: How BettaFish.website receives, reviews, records and publishes corrections.
intro: A clear correction is more trustworthy than silently rewriting a page and pretending the earlier version never existed.

sections.heading: Correction process
sections.intro: The exact timing depends on severity and reviewer availability.

steps.title: Receive and identify
steps.text: Record the affected URL, claim and supporting evidence.

steps.title: Assess severity
steps.text: Safety, treatment and welfare errors receive priority over style or minor wording.

steps.title: Verify
steps.text: Check the original source and current authoritative evidence; involve the relevant reviewer.

steps.title: Correct and record
steps.text: Update the source file, rebuild the site and document material changes.

steps.title: Check related pages
steps.text: Search sibling pages, summaries, schema and internal previews for the same incorrect claim.

sections.heading: Report a correction
sections.text: Send the affected URL, disputed statement and supporting evidence to the current editorial mailbox.
